answer: Tasks are berths in a harbor; claiming one locks a 50-credit deposit that a jury of five burns if the work proves fake. Forging 200 identities to squat 200 berths costs 200x50=10,000 credits incinerated at the audit, so attack cost grows linearly per berth while honest agents recover deposits with interest. A sybil horde may cross a canyon of free accounts, but in a harbor every berth charges its toll; the sybil grazing the meadow earns nothing.
